figures.before: Why Delivery Method Selection Is the Most Consequential Early Decision an Owner Makes
figures.alt: Construction planning table with drawings, measuring tools, a blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: The delivery method shapes how the owner, designer, contractor, consultants, schedule, budget, risk, and field decisions connect before the project reaches construction.

figures.before: Design-Build: Single-Source Contract for Design and Construction
figures.alt: First-generation commercial shell under construction with open structure, concrete floor, service rough-ins, and future tenant space
figures.caption: In design-build, design and construction are aligned under one contracting structure. The value comes from making the scope, performance goals, costs, constructability, and decisions visible early enough to act on them.

figures.before: Construction Management at Risk: The Hospital and Institutional Standard
figures.alt: Hospital life-safety coordination area with protected egress route, temporary construction separation, and clearly maintained corridor access
figures.caption: Institutional projects often need preconstruction and construction management to respond to operating constraints, phased work, life-safety requirements, procurement, and a controlled path to turnover.
